title: Hⁿ-measure of balls in an n-plane: Hⁿ(P ∩ B_s(0)) = ω_n sⁿ
statement: Let n, ℓ ≥ 0 be integers, E = Ambient n ℓ = ℝ^{n+ℓ}, P a linear subspace of E with dim P = n (finrank P = n), and s ≥ 0. Then (Hⁿ⌞P)(B_s(0)) = Hⁿ(P ∩ B_s(0)) = ω_n sⁿ. Precisely, ((μHE[n]).restrict P)(closedBall 0 s) = ENNReal.ofReal(omega n · sⁿ), where Hⁿ = μHE[n], B_s(0) is the closed ball and ω_n = omega n is the Lebesgue measure of the unit ball of ℝⁿ.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (P : Submodule ℝ (Ambient n ℓ)) (s : ℝ), Module.finrank ℝ P = n → 0 ≤ s → ((μHE[n] : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)).restrict (P : Set (Ambient n ℓ))) (closedBall (0 : Ambient n ℓ) s) = ENNReal.ofReal (omega n * s ^ n)
